name: 7th Kup

practical.title: Walking stance: back fist side strike
Turning kick into knifehand guarding block

theory.question: What is the meaning of the green belt?
theory.answer: Green stands for the growth of the plant, as Tae Kwon-Do skills begin to develop.

theory.question: What is 'Pushing Block' in Korean? (quiz widget)

sparring: Three-step sparring (Sambo Matsoki) numbers 5-7. Attack: three middle-section front punches in walking stance, starting right leg back in low block. Defences start from parallel ready stance.
5: Right-leg-back L-stance, two middle outer forearm blocks to the inside. Counter: move right into parallel sitting stance, left outer forearm block and high punch together.
6: Right-leg-back L-stance, two middle knifehand blocks to the inside. Counter: move right into parallel sitting stance, left outer knifehand guard and high inward knifehand strike to the neck.

7: Right-leg-back L-stance, two middle outer forearm blocks to the inside. Counter: slide back at 45 degrees into right L-stance with forearm guarding block, right front kick landing in right walking stance double punch.

otherSections.heading: Do-San pattern (24 movements)
items: Named after patriot Ahn Chang-Ho (1876-1938). Starts in parallel ready stance; ends with right foot back to ready posture.
1-4: High outer forearm side blocks and middle punches in alternating walking stances, toward B then A.
5-8: L-stance knifehand guarding block, straight fingertip thrust, left and right back-fist side strikes.
9-12: Same as 1-4, toward E and F.
13-16: Wedging block, front snap kick, two fast punches (15-16).
17-20: Same as 13-16, toward CF, kicking with left foot.
21-22: Rising forearm blocks, left then right.
23-24: Middle side knifehand strikes from sitting stance, left then right.

notes: Free sparring (Jayoo Matsoki) appears only in the terminology list; no free-sparring requirement on the page.
